text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major problem is bias. If the data used to train AI is unfair, the AI can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or healthcare. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI systems often collect personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it safely. Transparency is important too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create clear rules. This way, we can enjoy the benefits of AI while protecting people's rights.
